page.overview:
What is Solrock?

Solrock is an orange spherical Pokémon with eight spiny rock formations sticking out from the sides of its body, thus giving it the appearance of the sun. It also has tiny, yellow rocks embeded in its orange body. Solrock's eyes are squinted shut and the pupils are very small and red.

Despite appearing to be expressionless, Solrock is able to read the emotions and thoughts of its opponent(s). It is commonly seen in caves.

Solrock absorbs the sunlight to make it its own energy source, becoming much powerful during the daytime. By rotating its body, Solrock is able to produce heat and bright light, which it uses to blind its foes.

Solrock has the ability Levitate making it invulnerable to ground type moves. It is also capable of learning many Fire-type moves.
